summary: Computer Science and Software Engineering student at UC Irvine, double majoring with a specialization in Networked Systems. I have hands-on experience on both sides of a product: as a developer I have shipped full-stack applications and won two hackathons (ICSSC WebJam 2025 and IrvineHacks 2026), and as a UX designer at Commit the Change I am building real tools for Celebrating Life Community Health Center, a healthcare provider serving underserved communities in Orange County. I also teach JavaScript, Unity C#, and block-based programming at Code Ninjas and evaluate multimodal AI models professionally.
